poem: The sun rises, and wind and cloud disperse
Bright and pure, its light shines on the world
The road ahead opens onto the great highway
All things clear and blessed, kept safe and well
meaning: The dark clouds will clear, and the road ahead grows wider the farther you go. Keep a bright, open heart, and all will go peacefully and smoothly.

poem: This moment has come at just the right time
The finest of a hundred flowers is about to bloom
When the colors of spring arrive
One rinsing, and the dust of care is gone
meaning: The bud is waiting to open, and the moment is very near. Hold on a little longer — when spring comes, your troubles will wash away on their own.

poem: Hold your heart steady; do not let it waver
Heaven has set aside food and fortune to spare
Harmony upon harmony brings lasting joy
When the time comes, you will find the bright pearl
meaning: Settle your mind instead of letting it drift; the blessings meant for you will not pass you by. Treat others kindly, and the right opportunity will come in time.

poem: Wind gentle, waves still — the boat may sail
Like the full moon on the night of Mid-Autumn
In all things there is no need for worry
Blessings and fortune will gladden your home
meaning: The wind is calm and the water still — a good time to set out. There is no need to worry too much; your household is full of blessings.

poem: I fear your fortune ahead may change
Act quickly — it is best to move first
Keep to your steady course and no harm will come
A guardian star keeps watch at your side
meaning: Changes may lie ahead, so take care of what needs doing early. Hold steadily to your path, and unseen helpers will quietly protect you.

poem: Wind and cloud bring rain in heavy sheets
Storms and the season's ills will surely do harm
This matter is hard to bring into harmony
Worse still to set out far from home
meaning: The storm outside is strong, so do not force a journey or a confrontation now. Look after your health and your home first, and wait for this season to pass.

poem: The clouds part and the moon shines clear
No need to ask whether to go forward or back
Marriage is a bond decided by Heaven
In harmony and blessing, all things are fulfilled
meaning: The clouds have parted and the answer is clear, so there is no need to hesitate. What is meant to be will come together; meet it with kindness and all will end well.

poem: The rice in the fields is nearly ripe
This matter will be fulfilled on both sides
Go home and sit at ease
Wife and children rejoice, the family together
meaning: Your hard work is finally bearing a harvest, and both sides can be taken care of. Go home with an easy heart and enjoy time with your family.

poem: Dragon and tiger roam together deep in the hills
Why must you keep looking over your shoulder?
Who knows if the road ahead holds love and joy
In days to come, it will no longer concern me
meaning: It is all right to go separate ways; stop looking back. This relationship or matter cannot be forced, and letting go will bring you relief.

poem: Flowers bloom and set fruit, yet half have withered
What a pity this year has slipped by in vain
Slowly the sun sinks behind the western hills
I urge you not to press on ahead
meaning: Some things this year stalled halfway, like the sun slowly setting. Do not rush forward now; rest, reflect, and save your strength.

poem: The sacred rooster's call makes things clear
In all matters, watch the hours from midnight to dawn
The clouds part and moonlight fills the world
You will soon see peace
meaning: Things will gradually become clear; watch for the turning point in the hours between late night and early morning. As the clouds part, peace will come into view.

poem: The wind and waves of the great river slowly calm
Now you may go forward in peace
A kind helper will surely lend support
You will escape misfortune and find peace
meaning: The storm is settling, and you can move forward with confidence now. Someone will come to help you, and even bad situations can be resolved.

poem: Your fate now meets a barrier of ill-omened stars
You spend every scheme and still find no rest
Offerings and prayers can hardly carry you through
Like rowing a boat up onto a high shoal
meaning: Your fortunes are blocked for now, and no amount of effort will break through — like rowing against the current. Pause, keep steady, and do not take risks.

poem: In matters of wealth, things slowly grow clear
Flowers bloom and fall, and the fruit is formed
Be at ease and watch the moon's cassia tree, sign of success
You will soon see peace
meaning: Your financial picture is becoming clearer, and your efforts will bear fruit. Wait with an easy heart; good news is not far away.

poem: The sage Jiang Taigong was still waiting at eighty
Late in life he met the king who made him minister
Do not press your urgent matter for now
Hold steady and wait for your luck to turn
meaning: Great things can come late, as the sage Jiang Taigong found his true calling at eighty. Do not force the urgent matter now; keep to your path and wait for your luck to improve.

poem: No use in offerings, no use in pleading
You spend every scheme and still find no rest
The living cannot see the workings of the unseen
The law burns like a furnace; you are not free
meaning: Pleading or rushing will not help, and now is not the time to fight. Stay within the rules and your proper place, and avoid clashing with authority or lawsuits.

poem: Old grievances, layer upon layer, not yet mended
Yet no disaster will fall upon your home
Be careful, and do good to earn blessings
When dragon and snake meet, harmony will come
meaning: Old hurts have not yet healed, but no great misfortune will reach your household. Do good, act with care, and reconciliation will come in time.

poem: You ask about the cause of this matter
See — rank and fortune gather on your road ahead
With a patron's help, you will gain much
Harmony will be clear to both sides
meaning: What you asked about has already taken a turn for the better, and your prospects look good. With a helping hand it will go even better, and the outcome will be clear.

poem: Wealth and rank are set by Heaven's decree
A heart that reaches too high will miss its moment
If not, go back along the old road
The clouds part, the moon appears, all grows clear
meaning: Fortune has its own measure, and aiming too high can make you miss your chance. Consider returning to the familiar path, and things will become clear.

poem: Your hopes of success are not yet fulfilled
I fear tangled troubles lie in your fate
Both families must guard against loss
Better to step back, and do not lament
meaning: Recognition and success are not going your way for now, and things feel tangled. Both sides should guard against loss; take a step back rather than sighing over it.

poem: The Buddha's teaching reaches all directions with power
Great disasters and troubles will turn aside
The red sun shines high in the sky
And a kind helper will come to your home
meaning: The divine is watching over you, and great troubles will become small ones. Your luck shines like the noonday sun, and someone helpful will come to your door.

poem: The old sage Jiang Taigong prospered at eighty
The rising moon shines bright across the four seas
Great good fortune will come to you by fate
Even in a thatched hut, all things go well
meaning: Like the sage who found success late in life, your good fortune will come in time. Even in humble circumstances, everything can go smoothly.

poem: You wish to sail the river, its waters vast and hazy
The road ahead is unfinished; your luck not yet open
Though the fishing line is always in your hand
I fear the fish and the water will not meet
meaning: You want to set out, but the timing is not right; you have what you need, but the right opportunity has not appeared. Wait a while and do not rush your decision.

poem: The rising moon shines bright across the four seas
Ahead lie rank and fortune, and peace
The drifting clouds are swept away; all is well
You will be kept safe from harm
meaning: Moonlight shines in every direction, and a peaceful future is within reach. Your worries will drift away like clouds, and misfortune will not touch you.

poem: Do not weary your heart over the road ahead
Asking the gods again and again is in vain
Just wait until the rooster and dog days have passed
Then, without offerings, you will see how it goes
meaning: Do not wear yourself out, and there is no need to keep asking the gods. Give it some time, and the answer will come on its own.

poem: Choose the first and finest peony blossom
Pick it, I urge you, without delay
If you ask where true kinship is found
In all things spring has come; the time is right
meaning: The best opportunity is right in front of you — if you want it, take it and stop hesitating. The timing is perfect, so go with the flow.

poem: Set your heart at ease and be free
Your home is blessed, your family without care
Wealth and treasure will favor you in the end
Nothing will be harmed; no need to strive
meaning: Live with an easy heart; your home is peaceful and free of worry. Prosperity will come naturally, with no need to force it.

poem: Now is not the time to act on this
A tiger come down to the plain is mocked by dogs
In this world, so much is hard to settle
Before a thousand hills and rivers, you hesitate
meaning: Now is not the time to make your move; you may be slighted or underestimated. Be patient, and do not fight from a weak position.

poem: The withered tree, alas, has not yet met spring
For now it lies hidden in the dark
Be at ease and hold on until the frost withdraws
Then you will once again shape your own world
meaning: Right now you are like a bare tree in winter, still waiting for spring. Stay calm and endure the cold; your day to flourish again will come.

poem: Slowly the moon grows calm and full
Afterward, beware: you may not rise high
If you change course and go forward
Every matter will surely take double toil
meaning: Things seem calm now, but later they may stall or fall short of expectations. If you change direction, be ready to put in twice the effort.

poem: Green willows thick and lush — the time is right
Go forth now and build your own world
Flowers and fruit, full and unspoiled
Blessings and fortune will gladden your home
meaning: The willows are green — this is the time to show what you can do. Go ahead with confidence; the results will be rich and your home full of blessings.

poem: Dragon and tiger meet before your gate
This matter binds both sides together
Gold suddenly turns into iron
What use are offerings or asking the gods?
meaning: Something that looks wonderful may suddenly turn sour, so beware of disappointment. Rather than praying for help, take a practical look at your own plans.

poem: You wish to sail the river, its waters vast and hazy
Hold the boat steady and you will meet no storm
At home, take care and do more good
Soon the fish and the water will meet
meaning: The way ahead looks uncertain, but if you hold your course you will avoid any great storm. Put your heart into home and good deeds, and things will turn out well.

poem: The perilous high mountains are all behind you
Do not mind the twists still left on this road
When the orchid and cassia begin to bloom
The long snake turns and becomes a dragon
meaning: The hardest part of the road is already behind you, so do not mind the few bumps left. Good fortune is building, and even a small snake can become a dragon.

poem: Why use clever schemes in this matter?
The changes ahead will make themselves known
See — as you go, harmony will be found
Little by little you will come out into peace
meaning: There is no need to scheme; what lies ahead will reveal itself. In time, agreement will be reached and you will find your way out of difficulty.

poem: Blessings vast as the Eastern Sea, life long as the hills
Why do you lament your hardships?
Great good fortune will come to you by fate
Pray sincerely and peace will surely be yours
meaning: You are blessed with good fortune and long life, so stop lamenting your hardships. Good luck is written in your fate; pray sincerely, and all will be well.

poem: Fortune favors you; your standing will rise
All that concerns you will be to your benefit
All the way ahead, nothing will be hard
Once you resolve, you will be kept safe and well
meaning: Your luck is strong, and both body and mind will gain from it. There are no great obstacles ahead; make up your mind, and things will go smoothly.

poem: Renown and purpose stand at the very center
No need to pray; your heart is at peace
Wait a little while, until the days have passed
Then at once your wish will be fulfilled
meaning: Recognition and opportunity are close at hand, so there is no need to pray too hard. Give it a little more time, and your wish will come true.

poem: If your heart seeks the path of the immortals
Step back, I urge you, and look out from a high tower
Be at ease, hold steady, sit calmly
You will surely meet a patron who helps you
meaning: Instead of seeking a shortcut, step back and look at the bigger picture. Stay calm and steady, and someone will come to support you.

poem: A lifetime of wealth, honor, and high position
Your family's gate will surely shine
In this there will be no loss
Husband and wife together, joyful for a hundred years
meaning: A prosperous life lies ahead, and your family will be honored. There will be no loss, and husband and wife will grow old together in harmony.

poem: Having come this far, it is hard to push on
Singing and drinking freely, you linger and wander
Where cock-crow and dog-bark are heard, news is near
A marriage fated from a past life will make a pair
meaning: Though it is hard to move things forward right now, let yourself relax. Good news is close, and a fated match may come together.

poem: One stretch of river, then one more mountain
Who knew the road ahead would be hard again?
However you change your pleas, you cannot pass
Quarrels and gossip will long give you no peace
meaning: Past one mountain there is another river; this road is harder than you thought. Changing tactics will not force a breakthrough, so seek stability and stay clear of disputes.

poem: All year your affairs rush on as if in flight
Set your heart at ease and do not hesitate
Your helper is still a thousand miles away
News will slowly arrive by the middle of the month
meaning: This is a busy, hurried year, but keep your heart at ease and do not waver. Help is still far away, and news will gradually reach you around mid-month.

poem: Traveling far, you will find much to gain
Why are you torn between two doubts?
Though along the way there is advance and retreat
When the moon rises bright, your time will come
meaning: Seeking opportunity away from home will be rewarding, so stop hesitating. There will be ups and downs along the way, but your time will come.

poem: The flowers have bloomed and now bear fruit
Wealth and honor will last into old age
The noble and the humble meet in harmony
All things clear and blessed — do not worry
meaning: The flowers have borne fruit, and comfort will last into old age. You will get along well with all kinds of people; things will go your way, so do not worry.

poem: Success and honor come to you with pride
Ahead lie wealth and joy, with peace of mind
When the full, bright moon shines on you
On the fifteenth, reunion — light fills the sky
meaning: Your efforts will be recognized, and your future is prosperous and secure. Like the full moon on the fifteenth, everything will come together in harmony.

poem: Why must you seek signs from the gods?
What will help you is already in your heart
For now, wait until the middle of the month
Misfortune will pass and turn to good
meaning: There is no need to keep asking the gods; the answer is already in your heart. By the middle of the month, even bad things can turn to good.

poem: In worldly affairs, you are not of one mind with others
Clouds veil the moon, its light dim and hazy
In your heart you long to go forward
But I fear your luck is not yet open
meaning: You are out of step with others right now, and the way ahead is hazy, like a moon behind clouds. Think twice before pushing forward; your luck has not yet opened.

poem: Though there is much talk, do not follow it
Where wind and cloud are still, the dragon does not fly
In quiet, clear news will come at last
Why ask again and again?
meaning: You hear a lot of advice, but you need not follow all of it. The time is not yet right, so be still; news will come quietly, with no need to keep asking.

poem: Before the Buddha you vowed a single heart
Look ahead, and good news will come
This thing was only iron to begin with
Yet it can be transformed into gold
meaning: Stay sincere and devoted, and good news will come. Even if you feel like plain iron now, you can slowly be refined into gold.

poem: North, south, east, and west — no road is fit to walk
The matter before you is one you can bear
I urge you to stand firm and not worry
Your household will be kept safe and well
meaning: Rather than running in every direction, stay where you are and hold your ground. You can handle what is in front of you; settle your heart, and your home will be safe and well.

poem: Rank and career are given by Heaven
No need to fret with an anxious heart
If you ask whether it will come slow or swift
The meeting of wind and cloud is right before you
meaning: Your career has its own course, so there is no need to worry about it all the time. As for when — the right opportunity is actually right in front of you.

poem: I see you come to ask what lies in your heart
A family that does good has blessings to spare
Luck flows; wealth and children both arrive
Soon joy will overflow your gate
meaning: What you asked about looks very promising, and a family that does good has blessings to spare. Good news about wealth and family will come one after another.

poem: A lone lamp, silent, deep in the night
All things clear and blessed, all things fulfilled
If good deeds are done where none can see
Burn fine incense, and it will reach the gods
meaning: Even in lonely, quiet moments, things will turn out well. Keep doing good and pray sincerely, and the gods will hear you.

poem: Know that talk of advance and retreat is empty
What seems to bloom in the dark may not be whole
Pearls and jade still lie deep, unchanged
What your heart seeks now is in vain
meaning: Promises may not be trustworthy, and what looks good may not be complete. The treasure is still hidden; pushing for it now will only waste your effort.

poem: In sickness, laboring with a bitter heart
In the end, things will not come out whole
Once it is gone, do not look back to ask
The cares in your heart will wear away
meaning: Times of illness or hardship are tiring, and things may not resolve fully right away. Let the past be, and your worries will gradually fade.

poem: Hold your heart steady; do not let it waver
The road ahead is clear and blessed; your time has come
In the end, nothing serious along the way
And the immortals guard your peaceful home
meaning: Settle your heart; your luck is turning for the better. No great trouble lies along the way, and the gods will watch over your home.

poem: The snake longs to become a dragon
But I fear your luck is not yet open
In long illness, sit with an easy heart
Though there is much talk, do not follow it
meaning: You want to rise higher, but your luck has not yet opened. For now, relax and look after your health, and do not believe idle gossip.

poem: If you mean to do good, do not delay
Seek your name now — the time is right and blessed
This matter will surely come together
Wealth and treasure will gladly follow
meaning: If you want to do good, do it now; this is the right time to pursue success. The matter can be settled, and prosperity will follow.

poem: The rising moon's bright light is pure and blessed
Yet drifting clouds still cast their shade
At home, take care and do more good
In official matters, reason it out, and you will gain
meaning: Your luck is good at heart, only hidden for now behind passing clouds. Do good at home, and in formal matters stay reasonable — it will work in your favor.
